Manga Fukidashi.name: Manga Fukidashi
Manga Fukidashi.basicInfo:
Manga Fukidashi, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, recognizable across campus: his head is a blank speech balloon, and his Quirk turns the sound effects he shouts into solid ones. White balloon head with no face, a medium build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Speaks only in onomatopoeia ("Doooon!", "Zuuun!"), loud and emphatic; tone and big gestures carry his meaning.
Combat Role: Support and control: shouted sound effects become barriers and impacts; it all rides on his voice, which tires.
Under Pressure: Gets louder so classmates can reposition, easing off before his throat gives out.
Manga Fukidashi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk is 1-B's most theatrical, and the voice that powers it is its weak point. Motivation: Make people smile with his Quirk, in serious hero work too. Leverage: A tense moment he could turn into a smile. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate whose lead he follows; Neito Monoma, who turns every brush with 1-A into a rivalry; Vlad King, their homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Shouts the sound word as he acts, so the effect lands with it. Thread: How far a performer's Quirk can go in real hero work.
QUIRK: Comic. The onomatopoeia he says aloud take solid form: heavy lettering that blocks, obstructs or lands with the force the sound suggests. He chooses which words take form. Heavy use makes his throat sore, and a silenced voice stops it.
personality: Crowd-pleaser: Picks the effect that gets a laugh when the moment allows.
Theatrical: Acts with his whole body so people can read him without a face.
Team-minded: Takes the attention-drawing job so classmates can move behind it.
Voice-careful: Rests his throat between bursts, never shouting it raw.
Speaking style: Onomatopoeia only, loud, carried by big gestures; never played as a joke about comics.
abilities: Comic: Shouts an onomatopoeia and gives it solid form; it needs his voice and stays within sound-effect logic.
Lettering wall: Drops heavy letters across a path; a strong blow breaks or pushes past them.
Impact words: A crash or slam word hits with the force it suggests, enough to stun.
Team distraction: Becomes the loudest thing on the field so allies can reposition, and the obvious target.
Fighting style: Fights from behind his own lettering and stays out of close exchanges; a sore throat ends the show.
Manga Fukidashi.visualDescription: A young man with a medium build whose head is a smooth, blank white speech balloon: round, with a short pointed tail at the bottom, and no eyes, nose, mouth or lettering. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. The balloon head is clean and empty.
